summary: A compact, theatrical cabaret show at Asiatique The Riverfront, easy to pair with dinner or browsing the riverside complex. The official site currently advertises a 50-minute performance; its listed prices and timetable should be reconfirmed for December 2026.
whyGo: A polished, costume-led live performance in a convenient evening setting beside the Chao Phraya.
Straightforward to combine with Asiatique restaurants and shops, or with the venue's Thai dinner-and-show package.
bestFor: Visitors wanting a short, accessible-to-plan evening attraction with music, dance and elaborate costumes.
Groups who want to make one riverfront outing of a show and dinner.
skipIf: You prefer intimate or traditional Thai performance; this is a produced cabaret spectacle.
You need confirmed step-free seating, sensory details or exact 2026 showtimes before booking; contact the venue first.
duration: The cabaret itself is advertised as 50 minutes. Allow roughly 2–3 hours overall for arrival, the show and time at Asiatique; this is a planning estimate.
cost: Official website currently lists ฿900 for the show and ฿1,400 for Thai set dinner, Thai performance and show. These are current listed prices, not a guarantee for December 2026; check the official booking page before purchase.
hours: The venue contact page lists daily operating hours of 9:30–21:00, but this is not a performance schedule. Showtimes and December 2026 dates were not clearly published in the sources reviewed; verify on the booking page or with the venue.
bestTime: Choose an evening performance, then leave time for Asiatique before or after. In December, reserve ahead for preferred dates and arrive early enough to navigate the busy riverfront complex.
gettingThere: Address: Warehouse 3, Asiatique The Riverfront, 2194 Charoenkrung 72–76 Road. The venue directs BTS riders to Saphan Taksin, then the Asiatique shuttle boat; it also notes dock access for travelling and riverside-hotel boats. Allow extra time for the pier and venue walk, and check current shuttle service details on the day.
booking: Book through the official Calypso website's booking link and confirm the selected date, performance time, seat category and ticket inclusions. The official site currently lists show-only and dinner-plus-show tickets. No December 2026 schedule was confirmed in the reviewed material.
accessibility: The venue describes its riverfront location and transport but provides no detailed mobility, step-free route, wheelchair seating or accessible toilet information in the sources reviewed. Contact Calypso directly before booking if access arrangements matter.
practicalTips: Check whether your ticket includes a drink, dinner or any post-show interaction; inclusions may vary by ticket type.
Use the official ticket page for date-specific availability and current price, rather than relying on older reseller listings.
The venue lists phone numbers +66 2 688 1415–17 and +66 8 6349 1937–38 for enquiries.
decemberNotes: December is a busy Bangkok travel period and Asiatique is a popular evening destination, so book once your dates are fixed and budget extra time for the approach and crowds. No special December 2026 performance or holiday schedule was available in the official pages reviewed; confirm directly before arranging dinner or onward transport.
uncertainties: December 2026 show dates, start times, ticket prices and seat availability were not confirmed by the official pages reviewed.
Detailed accessibility arrangements are not stated online in the sources reviewed.
The advertised daily venue operating hours may refer to office or general contact hours rather than show operations.
